entities.name: Henrieta Todorova
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Henrieta Todorova was a Bulgarian archaeologist, specialist in prehistory, professor, corresponding member of the Bulgarian Academy of Sciences, corresponding member of the German Archaeological Institute in Berlin, and a foreign member of the academy Leibniz Scientific Society in Berlin.
